notes.title: REMASTER Announced! Savant - Ascent Anniversary Edition!
notes.content:
HERE WE GO! We couldn’t let Savant - Ascent’s 10 Year Anniversary go uncelebrated! 

Today, we are officially announcing Savant - Ascent Anniversary Edition, a complete remaster of the game! Check out the trailer for yourself and join the final ascent. More details below:

Visit the Steam page: http://bit.ly/savantgame

[previewyoutube=Lw5RvCS53hs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Everything![/h3]

There are some huge upgrades! Not only will the game feature suped up versions of the original bosses, but NEW bosses will put you through some truly intense battles as you ascend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5315797/2e8212f7ad5f1c0ee190332dfec362ad0b4f3dc9.gif[/img]
(Yes, the Laser Sharks gets to try to kick your ass for real this time!)

[h3]Welcome One and All![/h3]

We want to teach new players how to properly play, while upping the challenge for experienced ones! New to Ascent? This is the version for you! Mastered the original version? Well, just you wait!

There are new abilities & moves to master, like the double-jump & backflip! Accidentally jumped into a batch of baddies? Nope outta there! You can also do Power Shots mid air!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5315797/918eb72f2186a2a10524ce8c4ef717b683806834.gif[/img]

[h3]The Music![/h3]

Oh, and the best news!? Savant has officially joined D-Pad Studio as our lead sound designer and composer. He has created an ENTIRE new soundtrack for the game! He'll be dropping songs & teasers from the OST, so follow him on Instagram or Twitter for some juicy tunes: Savant ([url=https://twitter.com/SavantOfficial]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/savantofficial/]Instagram[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5315797/5df1a32990874ab66a9cb4c1b157938674164817.gif[/img]

[h3]More To Come[/h3]
Over the coming weeks, we’ll be sharing more from the game - so Wishlist the Anniversary Edition on Steam, and join us in celebrating 10 years of Savant - Ascent: http://bit.ly/savantgame.

notes.title: v 1.70.3 live for Mac OS X
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay guys, we've been all wrapped up in meeting Owlboy deadlines and traveling lately, but the new update is finally live for Mac, and it should work for the new El Capitan OS.

[img=http://www.savantgame.com/img/misc/miniSavant.png]

The changes are the same as the PC version, but here's the list nonetheless:

Change list: 
[list]
[*]Changed CD achievement from 6 to 7 CDs.
[*]Getting to the space stage now requires you to aquire the Philosophers Stone. 
[*]Golden Enemies no longer disappear in Endless Mode. 
[*]Removed flash effect on first shot. 
[*]Adjusted some colouring in the cape upgrade effect. 
[*]Fixed auto shoot! Press Middle Mouse Button to enter AutoShoot mode. This mode will take away uneccessary strain to your fingers.(remember also that you can press Q to auto-grab CDs)
[/list]

I will also try to get the Linux update up and running ASAP(hopefully within the weekend).

If you experience any issues with the update, plase feel free to get in touch at support(at)dpadstudio(dot)com or post in the Steam community :-)

notes.title: Happy Halloween - Update 1.70.3
notes.content:
Happy Halloween everyone! We celebrate by doing a couple of tweaks to the game, and you'll find list of changes below!

[img=http://savantgame.com/img/misc/savantMask.png][/img]

Change list:
[list]
[*]Changed CD achievement from 6 to 7 CDs.
[*]Getting to the space stage now requires you to aquire the Philosophers Stone.
[*]Golden Enemies no longer disappear in Endless Mode.
[*]Removed flash effect on first shot.
[*]Adjusted some colouring in the cape upgrade effect.
[*]Fixed auto shoot! Press Middle Mouse Button to enter AutoShoot mode. This mode will take away uneccessary strain to your fingers. 
[/list]

So, the biggest change is that you now won't be taken to the final stage immidietly after defeating the last boss. You'll now have to find another way to enter this stage. A lot of the reason for this, is because that stage is so challenging at this point, that you won't be prepared until you're fully powered up! Remember that you can collect additional CD pieces in the Endless mode, to upgrade your character.

I'm hoping to that this update will have fixed some controller issues with the XboxOne controller, if not(or if you have any other issues), please feel free to let us know!

support@dpadstudio.com

(changes released on Windows. Mac and Linux to follow shortly.)

notes.title: Update - GOTY Mode - v1.51.4
notes.content:
We spent the weekend trying to address a few of the bugs that has been reported in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/259530/discussions/]Savant Steam Community[/url], aswell as adding a little something extra!

GOTY mode has now been fixed up, and you can activate it by completing all of the achievements in the game. This will add a button on the Main Menu which let's you turn on GOTY mode.

When GOTY mode is turned on, enemies in the game will be replaced by goats-themed robots(and yes, we know it's a terrible pun).

We've added two new leaderboards for this occation, Vario GOTY(Time Attack) and Endless GOTY.

Other issues addressed in this patch is:
+ Fixed a crash when selecting CDs in the pause menu.
+ Fixed a crash that would occur when using chain attacks on enemy.
+ Fixed a couple of grammar errors.

We will continue to fix issues as they are reported, so please feel free to turn to the discussion community to report any faults.

Enjoy!

notes.title: The Void Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.savantgame.com/img/misc/voidUpdate.png[/img]

The free expansion to Savant - Ascent is live!

[b]New Features:[/b]
  + New stage, drifting through space.
  + The Samurai is waiting for you in the void!
  + Additional soundtrack and ability, now seven total.
  + Stage selection screen.
  + Achievement/Progress screen.

notes.title: New expansion teaser! Planned Release Oct. 22nd
notes.content:
Hallo everyone,

Last weekend we presented Savant at Raptus, and left the audience with a teaser of what's to come for Savant - Ascent. 

You can view footage from the presentation here: 
[b]Youtube:[/b] [url=http://youtu.be/Wdx34hxP-Zs]D-Pad presents Savant at Raptus[/url]([url=http://youtu.be/Wdx34hxP-Zs?t=6m48s]sneak-peek at 6:48)[/url].

[url=http://youtu.be/Wdx34hxP-Zs][img]http://www.savantgame.com/img/misc/savantFootage.png[/img][/url]

We'll be announcing the official release-date soon, meanwhile, here's some additional info on the game:


[b][i]Will the expansion be free to download?[/i][/b]
- Yes, all the new content will be free for those who already own Savant - Ascent. This is because we love the players(you guys). You're the ones who's been making this game a success. We've collected the numbers, soon surpassing 300.000 copies of the game sold. We're thinking this is cause for celebration and new content worthy of the players!


[b][i]What will the expansion add to the game?[/i][/b]
- A looong list of things! We were originally gonna update the game slowly over the weekends, but it turned out way bigger than we thought, and we decided to bundle it all up in one go: Here are just some of the improvements:
[list]
[*]New level + boss showdown
[*]New soundtrack and ability
[*]Stage selection screen
[*]Full controller support
[*]In-game achievement screen and progress tracking(cds collected etc.)
[/list]


[b][i]Will this be the final version of the game?[/i][/b]
- Maybe, maybe not. According to Savant lore, there's still one chapter left of the Alchemist's story. We might tell it at some point, although most of our time these days is dedicated to [url=http://www.owlboygame.com]Owlboy[/url], so we can't promise anything. After Owlboy is done, we will most likely jump onto other projects, and there might be a chance one of those will be Savant related(Simon and Savant has created a universe we can literally make 100s of games from).


[b][i]So, you're working on Owlboy still? When is it coming out?[/i][/b]
- Don't ask.



For most recent updates, feel free to follow D-Pad Studio on [url=https://twitter.com/DPadStudio]Twitter[/url].

[url=https://twitter.com/snakepixel/status/515212737795088384/photo/1][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/ByZnQPnIEAAsHOq.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Minor update(v1.39.99.2)
notes.content:
Ok, second part of our weekend bug eradication is live!

This version makes further fixes to shaders. 

You can now set shaders to: advanced, basic or off. Basic shaders will do a simpler shading on things like enemies and Savant's powerups. 

Advanced shaders will require more resources out of your graphics card but will perform some advanced color swapping on Savant's cape when it is powered up(if your graphics card does not support this, it won't change color at all).

I didn't get the chance to check out the possibility of adding Trading Cards, but will look into next weekend, as well as keep an eye out in the community for additional bug fixes/suggestions.

All the best
~ Jo, D-Pad

notes.title: Upcoming Achievements + Content
notes.content:
We've been hard at work adding achievements to the game, as achievements can provide a more solid sense of accomplishment when making progress throughout the game. BUT, as I see it, achievements in themselves are not enough to fulfill a sense of accomplishment when playing our game.

We've tried to pull off a few things when keeping the implementation of achievements in mind:

[img=http://i.imgur.com/sR2i8Jx.png]
[list]
[*]1. [b][u]They need to be actual achievements[/u][/b]. Grinding for an achievement is not reward enough in itself, we like to see people mastering this game, and as such, will be adding only achievements that we feel the player has to really fight to earn.

[*]2. [b][u]We're eager to add more achievements[/u][/b] as we see players getting better, and if we see that achievements actually brings value to the game experience. If you have any ideas for future achievements, please let us know.

[*]3. We've avoided adding achievements for [b][u]scores and best times[/u][/b], and instead added online leaderboards so you can challange friends/rivals. We've intentionally split the game into an online mode and a local mode, so that players who are happy with their own progress can avoid competing on a global scale.

[*]4. We wanted to reward the player in-game while also being awarded an achievement on Steam, but the game has many versions, some without any Steam connection. We've hopefully added enough content for players to do a new round of exploration, and later we might explore further the possibility of joining both in-game rewards with achievements.

[*]5. BUT, we thought it may be a great idea to [b][u]hint at the new hidden content[/u][/b] that is being added. From reading the descriptions of the achievements, you can now figure out that there are a total of 6 albums in the game, that there are secret new moves, and that you can obtain Ultimate Power etc. So the achievement page in itself becomes useful when trying to completing the game.
[/list]

The new update will be available very soon, and we'll announce it right here when it does! Hope you'll enjoy the extra additions!

notes.title: Quick post-launch report
notes.content:
We're getting some reports in that:
1. People are unable to control the game. This might be because the game has detected the controller, and is trying to look for input using the currently plugged in joypad. We will fix this bug asap, but for now, this can be fixed by either playing with you're controller, or unplugging it to play with keyboard/mouse.
2. The game does not support 1080p, which is because the in-game levels are acctually to small for this resolution. We will add support for this as soon as possible.

All the best, and hope you're enjoying the game :-D
